models.name: American Black–Scholes–Merton — QdFp
models.guidance: American calls and puts with a continuous dividend yield.
models.notes: Risk v0.43.5 uses optimized fixed-work pricing with absolute error at most 1e-4 * max(spot, strike) against the independent American value, including reference uncertainty. The API accepts price and IV only. Standard-five, all-ten and analytics requests return HTTP 400 unsupported_operation, including Auto resolving to QdFp. Engine derivative implementations are retained but not exposed. IV inverts the served price; its residual is not an exact-American volatility error bound. Numerical values and inverse availability change from v0.42.x despite the unchanged model_version. Engine domains and per-input refusals remain authoritative.

models.name: Black–Scholes finite difference (cash dividends)
models.guidance: American options with scheduled cash dividends.

constraints.description: Live-contract expiry in years; exact expiry has separate payoff handling.
Annual lognormal volatility; also the implied-volatility search band.
Annual continuous dividend yield, in addition to cash events.
Cash events strictly before expiry; the request separately allows at most 16 supplied events.
Sum of cash amounts strictly before expiry divided by spot.

models.notes: Live-contract ranges describe the pinned finite-difference solver; expiry price is intrinsic. IV searches the stated volatility band. Events at or after expiry do not affect price. The API accepts price and IV only. Standard-five, all-ten and analytics requests return HTTP 400 unsupported_operation, including Auto resolving to this model, before execution or charge. Engine derivative implementations are retained but not exposed.
